menu.newBylinaBody: The current bylina's progress will be lost: missions, retinue, supplies and the Darkness counter start over.
menu.newBylinaNote: Training, Quick Match and replays are not affected.

difficulty.title: Difficulty
difficulty.hint: Only the number of enemies changes.

battle.chargeBroken: The approach is made, but the strike did not happen.
battle.chargeHint: Close in and strike: press the target once more.

battle.defendFlavor: Set your feet, raise the shield, and ride it out.
battle.defendHint: Defensive stance: −25 enemy hit chance and −2 attack damage taken. Ends activation.
battle.fastPaceHint: Double speed is on: pauses, movement and effects run faster. Press to return to normal speed.
battle.noUsesHint: No uses remain in this battle.

objective.rescue: Lead the princess to the extraction zone
objective.recon: Reach the extraction zone and leave the field

battle.overwatchFlavor: Still as a mouse by the stone: wait, and do not blink.
battle.overwatchHint: Enter overwatch: reaction shot when an enemy moves. Ends activation.

reject.ILLEGAL: That action is unavailable right now.

battle.title: Staff clash

bogatyr.name: Bogatyr
bogatyr.desc: The wall of the host: sword, mace and shield. Takes the first blow and answers so the foe regrets closing in.

strelets.name: Strelets
strelets.desc: Strikes from afar: the bow finds the gap in cover, the hand cannon buys range with two action points and smoke in the face.

znaharka.name: Znaharka
znaharka.desc: Vasilisa keeps her people standing: heals at range, washes off poison and delusion, and calls a forest beast when it comes to it.

upyr.name: Upyr
upyr.desc: A skeleton of Nav. Heavy, and slower than the host, but it comes straight on and claws until it is put down.

leshy.name: Leshy
leshy.desc: Master of the thicket. Strikes with a branch from range, sets roots, and beside forest camouflage he is hard to reach even in the open.

kikimora.name: Kikimora
kikimora.desc: A poisoned needle and a borrowed skeleton: she poisons the wound and raises a fallen upyr that lies nearby.

volkhv.name: Volkhv
volkhv.desc: A master of delusion: panics the foe, leaves an illusion in his place and pulls an ally out from under the blow.

forest_beast.name: Forest beast
forest_beast.desc: A beast on the healer's short leash: it lives two turns, holds its tile and gives its side camouflage.

illusion.name: Illusion
illusion.desc: The volkhv's phantom: one tile and a single point of health, yet to the foe a living target that draws the blow.

recruit.name: Recruit
recruit.desc: A recruit without a class. The sling gives him reach but not experience: he does not last long under fire.

idol.name: Idol of Nav
idol.desc: An idol of Nav. It neither moves nor strikes: it stands until it is broken.

captive.name: Princess
captive.desc: The princess waits to be led out: she does not fight and keeps behind the host's shields.

baba_yaga.name: Baba Yaga
baba_yaga.desc: A general of Nav, and flying: neither pit nor level slows her, and panic and roots clear the way. Pushed to her threshold, she leaves alive.

solovey.name: Solovey the Brigand
solovey.desc: He opens the battle hidden and strikes first: his whistle wounds and knocks the target off its feet.

upyr_pvp.name: Upyr warrior
upyr_pvp.desc: A warrior upyr: the same skeleton, but harder and meaner — made for a fight between even sides.

leshy_pvp.name: Leshy guard
leshy_pvp.desc: A warden leshy: branch, roots and the thicket's camouflage on the side of whoever fielded him.

kikimora_pvp.name: Kikimora warrior
kikimora_pvp.desc: A warrior kikimora: poisons with her needle and raises the fallen, keeping her side from losing numbers.

forest_rat.name: Forest rat
forest_rat.desc: A rat of Nav. One is a mere nuisance; the swarm takes you by numbers, and each bites until it is swatted.

mikula_peasant.name: Mikula
mikula_peasant.desc: A peasant from Vyselki. Bare hands are worth little in the thicket, but give him a branch and he holds his own.

fedot_stranded.name: Fedot
fedot_stranded.desc: Mikula's neighbour, stuck in the mire. Until he is pulled out he can only wait, and hold on to his friend's boot.

slug.name: Slug
slug.desc: A slug crawls half as fast as the host, but it spits venom from afar and rarely misses.

info.hold: Hold the portrait for fighter details

sword.name: Sword
sword.flavor: The blade knows one job and does it honestly.

bow.name: Bow
bow.flavor: The string sings, and the arrow finds the throat on its own.

sling.name: Sling
sling.flavor: A stone is cheaper than an arrow, and no louder.

claws.name: Claws
claws.flavor: The forest strikes not with a stick but with what grew on the paw.

branch.name: Branch
branch.flavor: What you tear off is what you strike with. The tree is not asked.

needle.name: Needle
needle.flavor: Thin as a nail. Koschei's death sits on the point.

mace.name: Mace
mace.flavor: Spikes go through mail the way a finger goes through dough.

pishchal.name: Arquebus
pishchal.flavor: Thunder in the palm, smoke in the face, silence afterwards.

sword_debug.name: Sword (debug)
sword_debug.flavor: A lesson sword: it takes without asking, so that you learn.

bow_debug.name: Bow (debug)
bow_debug.flavor: A practice bow: it never misses and never asks.

teeth.name: Teeth
teeth.flavor: Small, but they hold on to the throat for good.

club.name: Club
club.flavor: A heavier branch — that is all the schooling it takes.

spit.name: Spit
spit.flavor: Wet, caustic and shameful. But it lands.

combat.preview: Hit {chance}% · dmg {dmg} · cover {cover} · height {height} · {flank}. Tap again to fire.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHint: Labels update immediately. The choice is stored on this device.
settings.showHintsHint: First-time tutorials in the campaign. Turning them off does not block progress.
settings.autoEndTurnHint: When your fighters have no action points left, the turn passes to the opponent without pressing the button.
settings.debugModeHint: Inspection tools (movement-cost overlay, auto-win) in battle. For developers and QA.

circular_sweep.name: Circular sweep
circular_sweep.flavor: One swing, and no one is left around you but your own.

breach.name: Breach
breach.flavor: The wall holds until it is asked to step aside.

shield_bash.name: Shield bash
shield_bash.flavor: The shield strikes not with its rim but with the weight behind it.

heal.name: Healing
heal.flavor: The weeping herb closes the wound before it stops burning.

cleanse.name: Cleanse
cleanse.flavor: Bitter water washes away the glamour, the poison and the bad dream.

summon_forest_beast.name: Summon beast
summon_forest_beast.flavor: A whistle in the thicket, and the beast comes — wild, but listening.

aimed_eye.name: Keen eye
aimed_eye.flavor: A squint, a breath — and half-cover stops mattering.

roots.name: Roots
roots.flavor: Roots wake underfoot and hold tighter than hands.

poison_needles.name: Poison needles
poison_needles.flavor: The needle does not wound. What stays in the blood does.

raise_skeleton.name: Raise skeleton
raise_skeleton.flavor: The earth sighs and gives back what it took.

panic.name: Dread vision
panic.flavor: Fear arrives first — and leads the rest behind it.

create_illusion.name: Illusion
create_illusion.flavor: A shadow will become a warrior. Not for long — but it will.

teleport_ally.name: Teleport ally
teleport_ally.flavor: A step that never happened: here a moment ago, standing there now.

evacuate.name: Evacuate
evacuate.flavor: Leaving alive is not cowardice; it is service you will yet render.

whistle.name: Whistle
whistle.flavor: The robber's whistle: wind in the ears and heels over head.

campaign.pickMission: Pick a point on the map
campaign.lostBody: The darkness counter reached {value}: the rite of the eternal night is complete, the campaign is over.
campaign.lostRosterBody: The druzhina has fallen: no fighter survived. The campaign is over.

darkness.title: The Darkness grows
darkness.text: Every mission feeds Koschei's ritual: the Darkness counter rises after both victory and defeat. If it reaches the limit, the eternal night falls before the Needle is found.

scan.title: Scanning
scan.text: Hidden map points are revealed by scanning from the Flying Ship. A scan costs one herb and opens every point within the radius.

wound.title: Wounds
wound.text: A fighter who finishes a mission at low health is wounded: aim, defense and mobility suffer. Heal them in the Infirmary — the tab at the bottom of the screen.

roster.title: The Warband
roster.text: This is your warband. A fallen fighter is lost forever; a recruit gains a class after two victories — the Sage wields panic, illusion and ally teleportation.

forge.title: The Forge
forge.text: The Forge crafts equipment for gold and herbs: weapons and charms. A crafted item is equipped during deployment and affects the next battle.

deploy.title: Deployment
deploy.text: Choose from one to five fighters — only they will enter the battle. The wounded carry penalties, the equipped carry weapons and charms from the Forge.

evacuation.title: Extraction zone
evacuation.text: The cells along the western edge are the extraction zone. A fighter standing there may leave the field with a special action: the rescued or the scout counts as survived.

general.title: General of Nav
general.text: This is no common foe: a General of Nav wields special powers. Kill him for good — his escape threshold lets him flee at low health and return in another mission.

first_battle.title: First battle
first_battle.text: Click a highlighted cell to move, click an enemy to attack with the main weapon. The "End turn" button on the right passes the turn to Nav. Newcomers are advised to finish the Training in the main menu first.

first_leshy.title: Leshy
first_leshy.text: The Leshy keeps its distance and shoots from afar, while its roots entangle the target — an immobile fighter cannot move. Close in and strike point-blank.

first_kikimora.title: Kikimora
first_kikimora.text: The Kikimora poisons — the poison ticks at the start of a turn — and raises fallen skeletons. Remove poison with the Znaharka's skill and kill the skeletons again.

campaign.missionActiveHint: Finish or abandon the started mission first.

missionResult.title: Mission result
missionResult.defeatHint: The druzhina fell back. Gather strength and try again.

deployment.title: Deployment
deployment.equipHint: Pick an item from the ship's supplies.
deployment.equipEmpty: No items in supply. Craft them in the Forge.

roster.trainHint: The recruit is ready to learn. Choose a druzhina class.

chamber.emptyBody: The chamber is quiet: no wounded.

scan.hint: The ship opens points within {radius} units
scan.nothing: No closed points within the radius

forge.equipHint: Crafted items are equipped when forming the deployment.

pvp.roomHint: Pass-and-play on one device. Hand the device over after each turn.
pvp.objective: Victory condition: destroy all enemy units.
pvp.passBody: The panel shows the side whose turn it is. The other side's panel and fog are hidden.
pvp.draftPick: Pick a fighter from the shared pool
pvp.appleLying: The apple lies on the field

net.creatingHint: Collecting local network addresses — the code appears in a moment.

net.guestHint: Enter the host code or load an image with the code.
net.guestAnswerHint: Send this code or image back to the host — entering it completes the connection.

net.badCode: Could not parse the session code
net.noQr: No code found in the image

net.spectatorBody: no commands are sent; free camera
net.spectatorJoinHint: A spectator joins with the same code — the host sets the role.

replay.title: Match replays
replay.hint: Recorded competitive matches: pass-and-play and networked battles.
replay.otherRulesNote: This replay was recorded under a different rules version. The outcome may differ from the actual battle.
replay.unsupportedNote: This replay was recorded in an unsupported format and cannot be played.

training.title: Training
training.hint: Three missions teach the basics. Go in order or pick any.

movement.title: First steps
movement.description: Grid, levels, pits, action points, movement and dash.
movement.intro: The training deck of the Flying Ship. Let us start with the basics: the grid, the levels and action points.
movement.hint1: Each fighter has action points. A move costs one, a dash costs two.
movement.hint2: Move to the highlighted cell: a normal step costs one action point. On this step only that cell is open.
movement.hint3: End your turn with the button on the right.
movement.hint4: Nice step! Now the dash: move to the highlighted far cell — a move for two action points at once.
movement.hint5: End the turn with the button on the right — a new turn begins.

combat.title: Combat
combat.description: Attack, cover, height, hit chance and damage.
combat.intro: Against Nav bravery alone is not enough: height, cover and a careful aim decide the outcome.
combat.hint1: The Bogatyr's weapons: the sword is quicker, the mace is stronger. The lesson starts with the sword — its button glows on the panel.
combat.hint2: The upyr hides behind cover. Step into the highlighted cell next to it: from the side cover does not help, and from above height wins.
combat.hint3: Strike the upyr with the sword: the weapon button and the target glow. An attack spends the remaining points — end the turn and repeat until the upyr falls.

skills.title: Skills & statuses
skills.description: Class skills, overwatch, poison and resurrection, summons, fog of war.
skills.intro: Three against Nav: the Bogatyr strikes, the Znaharka heals and summons, the Strelets shoots from afar. Try skills, the stance and overwatch.
skills.hint1: The Znaharka summons a forest beast: pick the highlighted skill, then the highlighted cell beside her.
skills.hint2: The Strelets stands watch (key 0): he will answer an enemy entering his sector. The fog of war hides everything out of sight.
skills.hint3: End your turn — and watch what Nav can do.
skills.notePoison: A fighter is poisoned! The poison ticks at the start of a turn — cleanse it with the Znaharka's skill.
skills.noteResurrect: The Kikimora raised a skeleton! Kill it again.
skills.noteSummon: The Znaharka summoned a forest beast: it fights for you and fades after a few turns.
skills.hint4: The Bogatyr is poisoned: the venom ticks at the start of a turn. The Znaharka will cleanse it — the skill and the target glow.
skills.hint5: The Bogatyr takes the defensive stance (key 9): while Nav strikes, the stance reduces the damage.
skills.hint6: The Strelets strikes from afar: the bow glows, the target is the framed Kikimora. Range and height decide.
skills.hint8: The Znaharka heals the most wounded: the skill and the target glow.
skills.hint9: Finish Nav off: follow the highlight — the Chronicler will point out every strike. The Kikimora may raise the upyr — slay it again.

over.victoryBody: The Chronicler writes the deed into the ship's chronicle.
over.defeatBody: Try again — the chronicle awaits its next chapter.

training.exitHint: Abandon training and return to mission selection.
training.allDoneHint: All three missions are done. The Chronicler is pleased — the Quick Match awaits you.
training.resetHint: Completed mission marks will be cleared.

objective.movement: Follow the Chronicler: a step, a dash and ending the turn.
objective.combat: Follow the Chronicler and defeat the upyr.
objective.skills: Try skills, the defensive stance and overwatch against Nav.

locked.actor: Another fighter acts on this step — that one is already selected.
locked.cell: The lesson asks for a different cell: move to the highlighted one.
locked.endTurn: Complete the step action first: ending the turn is unavailable now.
locked.generic: Follow the Chronicler's hint: this action is locked until the step is done.
locked.skill: The lesson asks for a different skill: the needed button glows.
locked.weapon: The lesson asks for a different weapon: the needed button glows.

objective.rescueFedot: Find Fedot and lead him to the light
objective.evacuate: Lead both of you to the west

m1.title: Brushwood
m1.intro: The outskirts of Vyselki. Evening. The elder asked for brushwood while it is light. My hands are empty — at least I will find a stick.
m1.outro: The rat was not alone. A cry comes from the forest — someone is calling for help.

m2.title: A Cry in the Thicket
m2.intro: Night. Someone cried out in the thicket — and the cry broke off.
m2.outro: Fedot is saved. The light is to the west. But he dropped his bow in the mire.

m3.title: The Path of the Upyrs
m3.intro: The glade beyond the mire. The ground is full of holes. I am going for my bow. Do not wait — the skeletons are already close.
m3.outro: The road is strewn with bones. And further, beyond the mires, darkened the place the dead came from.

m4.title: Vyselki
m4.intro: Vyselki. The shutters are closed, the huts intact. The people left for the river. There is little smoke.
m4.outro: These are not hungry beasts. They came from the barrow-field. If we do not stop it — Vyselki will not see the morning.

m1.endTurn: You have had enough for today. End the turn — and you will go on again.

m2.noise: You hear a suspicious rustle in the bushes — you should get ready.
m2.wave: There will be more of them than sticks. The light is to the west.
m2.gear: I dropped my bow in the mire when I ran. I will find it — and come back.

m3.blow: A heavy blow knocks back. The pit beyond it forgives no step.
m3.pit: You do not walk into a pit. You push into it.
m3.shot: Found it. No more stepping into the mire. This one is mine.

m4.poison: The poison drinks not in the blow — but at the start of your turn.
m4.join: I am here. I will lift the blight — click, if your hands reach.
m4.raise: She raised the skeleton. Once for this fight. Kill it again.
m4.source: They came from the barrow-field. The earth there has been swelling since last autumn.

info.overwatchEffect: Shoots anyone who steps into view
